rationale: User 2026-08-26: 120dpi looks correct. Vertical ConPTY junk also happens in official wezterm-gui — polish later, not GPUI-only. Major issue is paint lag (dir /a, scroll, especially typing) vs wezterm-gui. Cause: every PaneOutput reshaped the whole viewport and paint_image'd every glyph. POC now caches one RenderImage per unique line (stable ImageId while the line is unchanged; not a viewport bitmap — 010) and drains mux notifications so a burst is one notify. Still debug vs official release; still not the wezterm-gui GPU atlas. GPUI text_system remains a later option if this is not enough.
